# CHANGE LOG
********************************************************************************
Description of the fields of the change log:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FIELD     DESCRIPTION
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
DATE:     The date when the changes have been done
AUTHOR:   The author of the changes made
CHANGES:  This field has four subfields that are:
          Files:  List of the files affected by the changes
          Issue:  Brief description of the found issue
          System: System in which the issue has been found
          Solution: Adopted solution for the found issue
          (When more than one issue has been found on a same date, in the change log appear more blocks of these subfields)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
********************************************************************************

================================================================================

DATE:     19/01/2016
AUTHOR:   Daniel Santana-Cedrés
CHANGES:  Files:    main/line_extraction.cpp
          Issue:    Some changes
          System:   All
          Solution: In line_equation_distortion_extraction_improved_hough, we have modified the doxygen documentation of the main function, moving the description of the parameters to the header.
                    In the same function, we have modified the checking of angle and distance resolution using assert.
                    We have removed some unused or redundant variables.
                    We have included const modifier to vector<int> for the parameters which are not modified in the functions.
                    In line_equation_distortion_extraction_improved_hough, we have moved to the inside of the parallel loop the private variables.
                    We have updated the doxygen documentation.
          ----
          Files:    main/lens_distortion_procedures.h
                    main/lens_distortion_procedures.cpp
          Issue:    Some changes
          System:   All
          Solution: We have moved the structure E_accumulators to the cpp file.
                    We have corrected a mistake in one of the variables of E_accumulators.
                    In model_center_estimation_2p, we have updated the doxygen documentation and we have removed the distortion center as parameter.
                    In build_lr1_quotient_vector, we have reordered the arguments.
                    In undistort_image_inverse, the parameter d changes to const.
                    We have included a new enumeration variable called ImageAmplification, for the scale factor in undistort_image_inverse.
                    We have modified the code of fitting the image scale in undistort_image_inverse using a switch.
                    We have included in main/lens_distortion_correction_2p_iterative_optimization.cpp a new static const variable for the image amplification factor.
                    In undistort_image_inverse, we have modified the code for computing the maximum distance to the corner, using the function update_rsqmax.
                    In undistort_image_inverse, we have included two new functions: compute_division_l1r for computing the inversion using Newton-Raphson in the case of the dision model, and compute_scale for computing the amplification scale.
